lines:
flowchart TD
  Trigger["Resume, remount or visible-context replacement"] --> Source["Read authentic loader metadata from existing history"]
  Source --> Active["Recover active baseline and scoped changes; retain retirements"]
  Active --> Visible{"Applicable instruction events still fully visible?"}
  Visible -->|Yes| Reuse["Reuse represented content without duplicates"]
  Visible -->|No| Probe["Reconcile missing baseline and active nested scopes via authorized reads"]
  Probe --> Present["Present: current file text and digest"]
  Probe --> Absent["Confirmed absent: removal transition"]
  Probe --> Unavailable["Unavailable: last admitted bounded text plus stale diagnostic"]
  Present --> Budget["Apply shared restoration budget; preserve specific rules and report omissions"]
  Absent --> Budget
  Unavailable --> Budget
  Budget --> Commit["Atomically admit context delta before next model request"]
  Reuse --> Ready["Proceed with actual visible context"]
  Commit --> Ready
  Cache["Cache hit or summary prose cannot prove instruction visibility"] -.-> Visible
  Tests["Implement production-boundary synthetic-compaction tests with loader now"] --> Gate["Future compactor must pass same suite through its real replacement path"]
  Gate -.-> Trigger
  Cancel["Cancelled or rejected preparation retains last committed context"] -.-> Commit

data.title: Mandatory instruction restoration contract for future compaction
